info.title: GovCon QASP, PRS, SLA & KPI Surveillance Matrix API
info.description: Extracts Performance Work Statement (PWS), SOW, or SOO deliverables under FAR Subpart 37.6 and generates a complete Performance Requirements Summary (PRS) Table, Acceptable Quality Levels (AQLs), automated SLA/KPI telemetry metrics, FAR 46.4 surveillance methods, positive/negative incentive or invoice deduction formulas, a closed-loop Non-Conformance & Corrective Action Report (CAR) workflow under FAR 52.246, and a ready-to-submit QASP / Quality Control Plan (QCP) proposal narrative. Stateless, read-only, and idempotent.

post.summary: Generate GovCon Quality Assurance QASP And PRS Matrix
post.description: Transforms PWS/SOW/SOO tasks and service levels into a FAR Subpart 37.6 Quality Assurance Surveillance Plan (QASP), Performance Requirements Summary (PRS) matrix, Acceptable Quality Levels (AQLs), SLA/KPI telemetry thresholds, FAR 52.246 Non-Conformance/CAR workflow, and proposal-ready QASP/QCP narrative.

pws_or_sow_deliverables_text.description: Raw Performance Work Statement (PWS), Statement of Work (SOW), or Statement of Objectives (SOO) tasks, service levels, and deliverable requirements (30 to 75,000 characters).

contract_type_and_incentive_structure.description: Contract type and incentive structure ('Firm_Fixed_Price_FFP', 'Time_and_Materials_TM', 'Cost_Plus_Award_Fee_CPAF', 'Cost_Plus_Incentive_Fee_CPIF', or 'Hybrid_IDIQ_Task_Order').

example.pws_or_sow_deliverables_text: PWS Section C.3 (24x7 Zero-Trust SOC, Cloud Enclave Sustainment & Incident Response — DISA / MNIT Enterprise): (1) C.3.1 24x7 Security Operations Center (SOC) Triage: Contractor shall detect, triage, and contain Severity-1 cyber incidents within 30 minutes of SIEM alert generation with 99.95% monthly Splunk/SOAR platform availability. (2) C.3.2 Continuous ATO (cATO) & Vulnerability Management: Contractor shall remediate 100% of Critical/CAT-I CISA KEV findings within 48 hours and High/CAT-II findings within 14 calendar days. (3) C.3.3 Key Personnel & Cleared Staffing Continuity: Maintain >= 95% fill rate across all 24 FTE positions with <= 10 business days backfill for any vacancy.
